pageProps.title: Phantom Lady
pageProps.review: Through William Irish's masterpiece Phantom Lady, considered one of the world's top three mystery novels, we introduce an urgent mystery where the protagonist, falsely accused of murdering his wife, tries to prove his alibi by finding a mysterious woman.
pageProps.content:
## Review One of the books counted as the world's top three mystery novels. The protagonist, who wandered the streets alone after a quarrel with his wife, happens to meet a woman wearing an ```orange``` hat, has dinner, and goes to the theater. The protagonist returns home after parting with the woman, only to find his wife found as a corpse in the bedroom, and of course, the protagonist is designated as the first suspect. Even more, the dead wife was in a state of being strangled with the protagonist's tie.
The protagonist searches for the woman to prove his alibi, but knows nothing about her. Even the restaurant, the theater, and the taxi driver all say they did not see her.
This development causes an illusion for the readers as if the protagonist is the culprit.
This book is a classic mystery novel. One shouldn't say, "Why is this one of the world's top three mystery novels?" after having already read many latest mystery novels. It must have been an incredibly sensational work at that time.
